Name: Hange Zoe - NPC - Attack on Titan
Author: LittlePippi
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ukS39WS.png[/img]
﻿Meet Hange Zoë. Eccentric scientist, mildly unhinged monster lover and mushroom enthusiast! Drawn by rumors of strange creatures lurking in the mines, Hange now works for the Adventurer's Guild as their scientist. Days are filled with studying monsters up close, testing bizarre inventions and generally alarming everyone around them. 

Brilliant, chaotic endlessly curious and prone to rambling about experiments or theories no one asked for. But as your bond with Hange grows, you’ll uncover the fierce loyalty, sharp insight and surprising tenderness hidden beneath the madness.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3rTzPjX.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kcw6YIa.png[/img]
This mod contains mentions of war, depression/PTSD, crude and harsh language, and includes NSFW/spicy content in the marriage dialogue.

No prior knowledge of Attack on Titan is required. This mod is fully adapted to the Stardew Valley universe - no Titans, no supernatural elements beyond the established in-game magic and creatures. Hange is simply an old soldier trying to build a new life.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a9nQssq.png[/img]

[size=5][b][i]Frequently Asked Questions:[/i][/b][/size]
[size=2][b]Q: Can I add this mod to an existing save?[/b]
A: Yes, just make sure your game is closed when you do. The only strange thing that will happen is that some NPCs and Levi will act as if he has been there for a while. 

[b]Q: I want to play the update, can I do it mid-save?[/b]
A: Yes. Save and close your game. Download the update, replace it with the old one. 

[b]Q: I would like to translate the mod into -said language-, can I do that?[/b]
A: Send me a message first. If you have never translated a mod before, I will also gladly help and guide you. :)
[b]
Q: How does it work if I have Hange, Levi and Erwin installed story wise?[/b]
A: The characters will interact with each other, have special dialogue and changed events. You don't need them all, you can pick and choose who you want installed. The mods are made to function as standalone and together.

[b]Q: What gender is Hange?[/b]
A: The author of Attack on Titan has stated that Hange's gender and sex is ambigius. I have chosen to respect the author's words. Author's [url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/isayamahazime/archives/4388712.html]blog[/url]﻿, a [url=https://tsuki-no-ura.tumblr.com/post/185745472299/hanges-gender-references]translation[/url]﻿, [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230228031235/https://kodanshacomics.tumblr.com/post/73207971230/hello-i-wanted-to-ask-you-guys-a-question-about]statement 1[/url]﻿ and [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230210032902/https://kodanshacomics.tumblr.com/post/73423029266/i-have-the-attack-on-titan-books-and-you-said]statement 2[/url] from publisher, [url=https://attackontitan.fandom.com/wiki/Hange_Zo%C3%AB]wiki[/url], [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%80%B2%E6%92%83%E3%81%AE%E5%B7%A8%E4%BA%BA%E3%81%AE%E7%99%BB%E5%A0%B4%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9#%E8%AA%BF%E6%9F%BB%E5%85%B5%E5%9B%A3]japanese wiki[/url].

[b]Q: Can I have babies with Hange?[/b]
A: Yes! You will also get cute custom looking ones, not the vanilla sprites. Hange will always adopt, no matter your farmer's gender.

[b]Q: Why is Hange standing in underwear and sleeping in the kitchen? Why did Hange give birth and not my farmer?[/b]
A: You are using the mod PolyamoreSweet. Please refer those bugs to the creator of the mod.[/size]
